about_the_game:
Welcome to Flushfall! 

In this game, your goal is to battle the other 99 toilets on the map until you're the last toilet standing! Why Toilets? Why are you fighting? How did you get here? These are the questions that go unanswered the entire game.

Fighting Mechanics

"How do all these toilets fight each other?" I hear you asking. Well, they use the only thing toilets are truly afraid of... Plungers. As the player, you click once to kill anything in front of you! That's right, everyone is one tap!

You're never safe!

In a world of 100 toilets, where they're all fighting to be the last standing, you're never truly safe. Unless, of course, you become the winner. When you win, let's just say something magical happens.

Customization?

"Customization?" I hear you ask? This game has plenty. You can customise your toilet using points you earn from playing the game! Don't you worry though, you can't buy these points using real Money, there's no in-app purchases!

It's time to have fun and battle toilets in FlushFall!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10/11 (64bit)
  • Processor: AMD / Intel CPU running at 2.8 GHz or higher
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: AMD/NVIDIA graphics card with at least 2GB of dedicated VRAM and DirectX 11 support
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10/11 (64bit)
  • Processor: AMD / Intel CPU running at 3.6 GHz or higher
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: AMD/NVIDIA graphics card with at least 4GB of dedicated VRAM and DirectX 11 support
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
